topic: Congruences, finite modular recurrences and separators for prescribed 14325 packings
title: Modular recurrences and alternative proofs of Blitvić, Kammoun and Steingrímsson's 14325 packing congruences

creators.name: Zhang, Wenlin
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: Starting from Blitvić, Kammoun and Steingrímsson's Jacobi-fraction theorem (Part II, arXiv:2611.12829v1, Theorem 9.2, 9 November 2026), we extend their congruence observations in Part I (arXiv:2610.29846v1, Section 7, item 11, p. 49) to finite linear recurrences modulo every integer coprime to six. In particular, the prescribed 14325 packing count is one modulo thirty-five for an odd number of windows and six for an even number. An alternative proof of the original modulo-ten and four-divisibility laws uses Wallner's rank recurrence and Catalan numbers. For prescribed mixtures of overlaps one and two we give product congruences and characterize exactly when the comparison poset has a separator.
summary: For every modulus m>=2 coprime to six, the prescribed 14325 packing count has a rational generating function modulo m, obtained from a finite Jacobi matrix cut off at the first r with m dividing 36r^2-1. Thus it satisfies an explicit recurrence of order at most r. For all j>=1, A_j is 1 modulo 35 when j is odd and 6 when j is even. For j>=2, A_j is 36*6^(j-1)+35*C_j modulo 140. The original modulo-ten and four-divisibility laws are reproved from the recurrence recorded by Michael Wallner in 2024. Mixed overlaps factor over maximal overlap-two blocks; their poset has a separator exactly when at least two blocks have at least two windows.
